Real Wages +2.4%, Yet the Vibe Is 46.4――『給料が増えたのに使わない』日本を追う

Real wages rose 2.4% year-on-year in July 2026 and real GDP grew 0.4% quarter-on-quarter in Q2. それでもprivate consumption was flat, household spending fell 3.6% year-on-year, and the August Economy Watchers current-conditions DI was 46.4. Five indicators seem to describe five different Japans. 所得・支出・景況感・時間軸に分けて事情聴取すると、『稼げない』より『稼いだ金が動かない』というtransmission problemが見えてくる。
